frozen_guarantees: Policy engine contains no family-specific primitive/path/profile literals.
Runtime inputs grow by opaque-ID state entries, not family-specific request fields.
Only validated registry descriptors are selectable.
Resident reuse does not reapply acquisition thresholds.
Lifecycle eviction and outside-domain preservation are descriptor-driven.
Acquisition choice is threshold- and priority-driven from registry data.
One decision selects at most one acquisition path; no hidden retry chain.
Reference family decision behavior is preserved across the exhaustive frozen state matrix.
A second family is selectable without changing generic policy source.
